claims.text: Most service businesses book every inbound call without a qualifying filter, sending estimators to jobs that were never close to buying.
A three-question phone filter (urgency, prior quotes, budget range) separates real buyers from tire-kickers before a drive is scheduled.

claims.text: Meta's Business Agent answers customers automatically in their own tone across WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram, qualifying leads and booking appointments
More than one million businesses were already piloting a version of the agent before the global rollout
The agent operates inside Meta's own chat apps and does not unify phone calls, web form leads, or walk-ins into one pipeline
A unified CRM behind every channel keeps leads visible regardless of which channel the agent doesn't cover
Customer satisfaction is highest immediately after the job finishes, before daily life takes over
People read and respond to texts faster than emails sent later
The free AI Follow-Up Builder can draft a referral-ask sequence for a business
